problem: A batch operator runs the export command after records are processed. When any record fails, the command still reports a clean run, so the operator automation does not retry the failed batch.
outcome: The batch operator can distinguish a run where any record failed from a run where every record succeeded.
acceptance: A run where every record succeeds reports success.
A run where any record fails reports failure to the batch operator.
The operator can identify the affected batch from either result.
